sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body: At its core, Alien: Evolution is a 2D side-scrolling game that challenges players to explore multiple worlds, each consisting of three levels. The game features two movement mechanics: a fast and agile flight mode, and a slower, more strategic glide mode. Players can switch between these modes at will, depending on the situation. The game also offers two different types of enemies, each with unique behaviors and attack patterns. To progress through the game, players must destroy these enemies using a selection of two powerful weapons. But that's not all - the game also includes a variety of power-ups and bonuses to enhance gameplay and provide a competitive edge.
